title: NTL pool checkpoints
description: ModernBERT-base and DeBERTa-v3-base fine-tuned on the Name That LLM open pool (18 classes, labels in config.json id2label), plus ModernBERT-base-mix: ModernBERT-base continued on all of train.csv (x5) mixed with 20k pool rows. Load the tokenizer from tokenizer.json with PreTrainedTokenizerFast (saved by transformers 5.22).
